Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: STP has 98% birth registration (World Bank 2023) and strong digitization of civil registration since 2018 Decree (computerization of CRVS acts). Civil registration is described as the foundation for the MOSIP digital ID initiative. However, IBA report notes no clear linkages between registration and identification databases and other databases. Integration improvement planned.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: MOSIP-based digital ID pilot underway (confirmed at ID4Africa 2025). Mass enrollment targeted for Jan/Feb 2026. Current civil registration/ID system lacks clear linkages with other databases. IBA report notes currently no official database for civil ID, visas, or nationality documentation. Integration planned once digital ID is deployed.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: STP was among ten African countries to benefit from AfDB digital trade and digital payments project (2023). E-Signature Law was passed (documented in April 2025 World Bank ISR). However, no documented operational integration of national payment systems with a data exchange platform.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: National Framework for Interoperability (Law 1/2024) creates legal basis for data sharing by public authorities. Personal Data Guarantee and Protection Law (Law 03/2016) provides data protection framework. E-Signature Law passed (referenced in World Bank ISR April 2025). Electronic Communications Law and Law on Regulatory Authorities approved by Council of Ministers (pending National Assembly approval).

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: National Strategy for Digital Governance (2020) outlines framework for digital governance across nine thematic axes and includes data sharing objectives. National Framework for Interoperability (Law 1/2024) creates a legal framework for data governance and inter-institutional data sharing. Data governance strategy and policy scheduled for release October 2025 under World Bank project.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: No operational data exchange/interoperability platform exists as of September 2025. World Bank Digital STP Project (P177158, effective Feb 2023) targets interoperability solution to be operational by June 2027. As of Apr/Sep 2025, indicator 'Interoperability solution operational' shows 'No'. National Framework for Interoperability (Law 1/2024) adopted but not implemented.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Internet penetration 57% (Jan 2024). World Bank project notes limited access to electricity, internet, and mobile communication. Small country but significant digital divide. Focused on basic connectivity improvements.
